segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַזִּיז; עַד טֶפַח – יֵשׁ לוֹ חֲזָקָה,
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a projection» emerging from the wall of one’s house, overhanging a courtyard, one «has» the means to establish «an acquired privilege for its» use if it protrudes at least «as far as a handbreadth,»

segments.he: וְיָכוֹל לְמַחוֹת. פָּחוֹת מִטֶּפַח – אֵין לוֹ חֲזָקָה, וְאֵין יָכוֹל לְמַחוֹת.
segments.en: «and» the owner of the courtyard «can protest» its construction. If it protrudes «less than a handbreadth,» the owner of the house «has no» means to establish «an acquired privilege for its» use, «and» the owner of the courtyard «cannot protest» its construction.

positions.claim: a projection of a handbreadth gets chazaka and may be protested; less than a handbreadth, neither
